title: SAML Metadata Orchestrator and Admin Guardrails for Onboarding
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an enhanced SAML 2.0 onboarding flow called the Metadata Orchestrator that centralizes metadata exchange, runs layered validation heuristics, provides a safe dry-run mode for admins, and surfaces RBAC v2 and audit logging guardrails during connector creation. This ticket covers the backend validation pipeline, admin-facing UX hints in the setup flow, and integrations with audit/event streams and RBAC enforcement points. Goal: reduce SSO setup failure rate and mean time to onboard while preserving auditability and least-privilege controls.
acceptance_criteria: Setup flow exposes a dry-run mode that simulates assertion flow and logs simulated events to the audit pipeline without persisting connector as active
Metadata Orchestrator validates incoming IdP metadata for schema, signature trust, entityID canonicalization, and certificate rotation windows; validation failures surfaced with actionable fixes
When RBAC v2 is enabled, the wizard shows required admin roles and prevents activation until an admin attests or RBAC policy is provisioned
All metadata exchange steps generate structured audit events (connector.create.dryrun, connector.metadata.validated, connector.activated) sent to the audit logging service with tokenized PII
E2E tests cover malformed metadata, expired certs, clock skew scenarios, and replayed assertions; CI gates must pass
Documentation and an admin checklist (Confluence) published and linked in the final screen
testing_notes: Run the dry-run against three internal IdPs (Okta, ADFS, AzureAD) and validate audit events emitted
Inject certificate expiry and signature changes using the saml-test-harness and confirm validation messages are actionable
Simulate clock skew (±5 minutes, ±1 hour) and ensure user-facing remediation guidance is correct
Run RBAC v2 gating: create connector with missing admin roles and confirm activation blocked until attestation
rollout_plan: Feature flag behind 'saml_metadata_orchestrator' for 10% of orgs
Enable dry-run preview by default for customers with >50 seats for one week
Monitor onboarding failure rate and audit event volume for 72 hours; rollback flag if failures spike >3x baseline
Ship admin checklist and update Console help center
